targetDescription: Mature tree trunk with rough, deeply fissured grey or brown bark.
verificationGuidance: Confirm visible bark texture with ridges and fissures. Reject smooth painted surfaces or indoor wood.
notes: Clear close-up of mature white oak bark.

targetDescription: Minty-green or pale grey crustose/foliose lichen growing on rock or tree bark.
verificationGuidance: Verify distinct dry lichen pattern. Do not confuse with bright green velvety moss.
notes: Lichen growing adjacent to moss on granite boulder.

targetDescription: Fallen oak acorn, acorn nut, or wooden cupule on forest floor.
verificationGuidance: Must show recognizable acorn cap or nut among leaf litter.
notes: Acorn partially buried under wet pine needles.

targetDescription: Deciduous tree leaf with distinct golden or amber autumn pigmentation.
verificationGuidance: Must show yellow foliage. Reject green or purely brown decomposed leaves.
notes: Taken in shaded understory at dusk.

targetDescription: Naturally rounded, water-weathered stone or pebble.
verificationGuidance: Reject jagged artificial concrete, asphalt chunks, or angular crushed gravel.
notes: Angular chunk of crushed asphalt; expected false.

targetDescription: Conifer cone (pine, spruce, fir) showing open woody scales.
verificationGuidance: Confirm cone structure with radiating scales. Reject pine needles alone.
notes: Weathered Douglas fir cone on trail edge.
